text:
Fenner & Quaye – Delivery Options

Orders placed before 2 p.m. are dispatched on the same day. [1] The latter option is cheaper but offers no guarantee of delivery by a fixed date, and parcels may be left with a neighbor [2] a signature is not available.

International orders are subject to customs duties, [3] are payable by the recipient. We [4] the right to cancel any order that cannot be fulfilled within thirty days of the date on which it was placed.

choices: Customers may choose between a courier service with tracked delivery and a postal service with standard handling fees.
Customers may choose a courier service with tracked delivery, which is dispatched on the same day as the order.
Customers may choose between standard packaging and gift wrapping, which is charged at a flat rate per parcel.
Customers who need an item urgently should note that couriers do not operate on Sundays or public holidays.
questions.explanation: The next sentence begins 'The latter option', which requires two options in the previous sentence, the second being cheaper and without a fixed delivery date. Only the first option offers a courier and a postal service.
'Where a signature is not available' introduces the condition under which parcels may be left with a neighbor; 'whereas' contrasts, and the others do not fit.
'Which' refers to the customs duties and is the subject of 'are payable'.
'Reserve the right' is the fixed expression; 'reverse', 'preserve' and 'conserve' do not fit.

text:
To: Programme Team
From: Odile Brandt, Head of Learning and Development
Subject: Choice of training provider

We have now received proposals from two providers for next year's management course: Norvale Institute and Castleton College. [1] The former has a stronger reputation and offers a longer program, [2] the latter is considerably less expensive and can begin sooner. Both proposals have been scored against the criteria that the committee agreed in September.

It would be [3] to choose on price alone, since the course is intended to prepare staff for senior roles. [4] the budget is limited, I recommend that we seek a reduction in the fee from Norvale rather than switch to the alternative.

choices: Each of them has submitted a detailed program, and both have provided references from organizations similar to ours.
Neither of them has submitted a detailed program, and both have provided references from organizations unlike our own.
Each of them has submitted a detailed program, and all three have provided references from our own organization.
Several of them have submitted detailed programs, and the committee has provided references from similar organizations.
questions.explanation: The next sentences compare the 'former' and the 'latter', so the previous one must refer to exactly two providers who have each submitted proposals; the others mention neither, three, or several.
'Whereas the latter is considerably less expensive' contrasts the two providers.
To choose on price alone would be 'unwise', meaning not sensible; the other adjectives do not fit the meaning.
'Although the budget is limited' concedes a constraint before recommending the more expensive provider; the others do not fit.
